mathematical_semantics: authority is a product order over per-coordinate partial orders admitting incomparable states; no faithful scalarization of incomparability exists (any real-valued score forces an order), so scalars are declared policy projections only
with certificates C_t(c) monotone in t and validity predicate nu_t, current authority is a view over history; revocation flips validity without erasing the certificate event

transition_semantics: deterministic: certificate event, revocation event or policy change recomputes the authority view; no operation mutates a stored certificate
uncertainty and authority occupy different axes: high authority with high uncertainty is a legal state and neither implies the other
